rationale: Default-off experiment in the host-snapshot Direct RSH integral-response consumer, retaining only the two-electron response inside an immutable prepared owner after exact comparison of the authenticated density. W-dependent Pulay and one-electron response always run; bounded optional storage refusal preserves computation. Public prepared items with native stationary-force capability bypass this consumer, so enabling this selector does not promote or accelerate their native endpoint. The native VV10 component reuse default is a separate policy.
revisit_condition: First identify actual endpoint ownership; do not qualify compatibility-route gains as native-default gains. Require independent complete E/F, geometry/one-ULP/failure/resource invalidation and source-bound complete 48/96-atom cold/warm/moved populations before promoting this consumer. The October 14 qualification used the historical VV10 rho>=1e-8 v1 domain; it cannot qualify the current rho>=1e-10 v2 domain or serve as its independent oracle. Retain exact protocol checks, unchanged energy/force gates and separate controls for geometry-response reuse.
